title: —Certainly, said Dante. It is a question of public morality. A priest would not be a priest if he did not tell his flock what is right and what is wrong.
html_source:
Mrs. Riordan, or “Dante,” is an absolute follower of the Roman Catholic Church, and she entirely follows the church’s “denunciation” of Parnell for his “divorce crisis”.

Mr. Dedalus, Mr. Casey, and Uncle Charles would rather support Parnell, regardless of such circumstances, thus causing such a heated argument as this.

anchor.text: —Certainly, said Dante. It is a question of public morality. A priest would not be a priest if he did not tell his flock what is right and what is wrong.

 —It is religion, Dante said again. They are right. They must direct their flocks.
